rationales.F03: History of laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma increases the likelihood of metastatic disease to the pacemaker site.
rationales.F04: History of bladder urothelial carcinoma increases the likelihood of metastatic disease to the pacemaker site.
rationales.F06: Recent COVID-19 infection could be related to a post-COVID-19 pacemaker pocket infection.
rationales.F08: New swelling over the pacemaker site could be related to various conditions including metastatic disease, pacemaker pocket sarcoma, or lymphoma.
rationales.F11: Soft tissue mass with increased vascularity surrounding the device is highly suggestive of a malignant process such as metastatic disease, pacemaker pocket sarcoma, or lymphoma.
rationales.F12: Exclusion of haematoma or infection decreases the likelihood of a pacemaker site abscess or post-COVID-19 pacemaker pocket infection.
